# Reality-grade banking

> The open standard for interacting with the proof-native economy. Receiz supplies the reality-grade infrastructure through its SDK, MCP and AI Skills. Bankeiz is an open implementation.

## The relationship
- Proof-native economy: participating value carries the required source, rights and evidence.
- Reality-grade banking: hold, inspect, receive and move that value while preserving its authority and history.
- Reality-grade infrastructure: Receiz implements identity, proof, ownership, Settlement, verification and continuity. SDK, MCP and AI Skills compose those existing primitives.

Private identity originals, signing material and private account records are not public documentation. A valuation, listing or model answer cannot replace original proof, ownership authority or exact financial approval. Read the applicable source and operation. This descriptive index creates no proof or execution authority.
